input: Book a sunset sailing trip for the group

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The number of people and who they are (adults, kids, mixed ages) directly affects which vessels are eligible, pricing tiers, and whether a private charter vs. public tour is more appropriate.
The sailing location (coastal city, lake, resort destination) and the target date or date range are non-negotiable inputs for any actual search or booking.
The total or per-person budget determines which class of operator to target — budget group tours vs. premium private charters — and filters out unsuitable options early.
Whether this is a private charter or a shared/public sailing tour completely changes the booking process, cost structure, and experience level.
The purpose of the trip (birthday, corporate, casual hangout) and any desired extras like drinks, food, or music shape which operators and packages to prioritise.
Knowing who is doing the actual booking — and whether they need help finding options vs. just confirming a shortlist — determines the immediate next action.
Understanding what 'a great trip' looks like (scenic route, party vibe, relaxed atmosphere, photographer on board) ensures the chosen option genuinely satisfies the group.

gold.taskTitle: Book a sunset sailing trip for the group
gold.taskDescription: Research and reserve a sunset sailing experience for a group of people, handling all booking logistics from finding options to confirming the reservation.

questions.title: How many people are coming on the trip?
questions.description: Establish the exact or estimated headcount for the group to determine vessel size requirements and whether a private charter or public tour is more suitable.

questions.title: Where and when should the sailing take place?
questions.description: Identify the specific location (city, marina, or destination) and the target date or date range to make the search actionable.

questions.title: What is the total or per-person budget?
questions.description: Pin down the spending limit to filter operators and packages appropriately from the start.

questions.title: Should this be a private charter or a shared public tour?
questions.description: Clarify whether the group wants the boat exclusively to themselves or is comfortable sailing alongside strangers on a group tour.

questions.title: What is the occasion or vibe the group is going for?
questions.description: Understand the purpose of the trip and any preferred atmosphere — celebratory, romantic, corporate, or casual — to match the right operator and package.

questions.title: Are drinks, food, or any extras expected to be included?
questions.description: Determine whether the group expects onboard catering, an open bar, music, or other add-ons, as this significantly narrows which packages qualify.

questions.title: What would make this trip feel like a true success?
questions.description: Capture the group's top priority — a specific scenic route, a lively party atmosphere, a calm relaxing sail, photos, etc. — so the final choice genuinely hits the mark.
